formal_role: Defines how nearby values estimate a derivative
systems_modeling_role: Controls whether estimates are forward backward central or higher-order
review_warning: The formula should be documented especially near boundaries

formal_role: Defines spacing between sampled values or perturbations
systems_modeling_role: Controls truncation error roundoff error and data-noise sensitivity

formal_role: Defines derivative estimates at the beginning end or edge of data
systems_modeling_role: Controls interpretation near time-series endpoints or spatial boundaries
review_warning: Boundary derivatives are often less reliable than interior derivatives

formal_role: Defines smoothing filtering interpolation or statistical estimation
systems_modeling_role: Prevents derivative estimates from amplifying measurement noise unchecked
review_warning: Smoothing choices should be justified and not used to hide uncertainty

formal_role: Compares derivative estimates against known or simulated truth
systems_modeling_role: Helps identify formula step-size or implementation errors
review_warning: Synthetic benchmarks do not guarantee empirical validity

formal_role: Defines whether derivative estimates are exploratory diagnostic or decision-supporting
systems_modeling_role: Clarifies how strongly rate estimates should be used in conclusions
review_warning: Derivative estimates should not be overstated when data quality is weak
